part.text:
I stopped the robot and put it into rest mode without reaching the red wall, so the task is not complete.

The robot followed the corridor through several turns, but it ended at a grey wall about 0.4 m ahead, with walls close on both sides and no red wall in view. Its last panorama showed no opening ahead, so this looks like a dead end, or the route turned somewhere I missed. I did not back up or search for another branch.

The robot is now resting (crouched, motors off) at about 4.0 m forward and 1.1 m left of the start, with battery at 99%. If you want me to continue, I can back out and check the side openings I passed, or you can guide it from here.
